column1: # The exits of the bash sensors that differ from nuc's by API-git-only-sensors-under-sense, read by
# scripts/lib/sensor-parity.sh: a bash sensor that cannot read its input exits 1 where it measures
# nothing, and nuc sense exits 2 for every cause that keeps it from deciding
# (API-command-line-with-sense). One row per pair, five fields separated by tabs: the sensor; the
# releases it holds on, separated by commas, or '-' for every release; the bash's exit; nuc's exit;
# and the cause. A difference no row lists fails the harness.
